title: Histoire et Légendes app
description: Management web application for a board game and role-playing association (Lescar): member area (session and tournament sign-ups, membership fees, statistics), full administration with Filament (members, treasury, seasons), push notifications and a public showcase page fully editable from the admin. Deployed in production on AlwaysData.

title: Self-hosted home lab
description: Home lab built from a second-hand PC and refurbished hardware, running OpenMediaVault (Debian): nearly twenty self-hosted containerized services (file storage and sharing, photos, movies and TV shows, passwords, documents…), secure remote access through Tailscale, monitoring with Uptime Kuma and Beszel, and full operations documentation (maintenance, updates, backups, troubleshooting).

title: Web Portal & CRM
description: Web developer internship: functional needs analysis, development of an administrable portal with Laravel and Filament, involvement across the full cycle (analysis, design, development, testing, deployment).

org: IUT de Bayonne et du Pays Basque
title: Client/server chat in C
description: Advanced programming module project: a command-line chat application over TCP sockets. Multi-client server (one thread per client, shared state protected by mutexes), messages broadcast to every participant, channel history sent to each newcomer, custom protocol (length then message) and careful dynamic memory management.

org: IUT de Bayonne et du Pays Basque
title: Shortest path in Bayonne
description: First-year project (semester 2): modelling the Bayonne road network as a weighted graph (over 3,000 vertices built from GPS coordinates), implementing and comparing Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford and A* (Haversine heuristic), with an animated display of the exploration and the resulting path on the map.

title: Yujo social network
description: Team development, agile methodology, of a web application centered on customizable virtual rooms.
